title: SDLC guard path/command policy
description: Version 1.0.0 of the fixed glob dialect published by spec v3 C.7.3: `*` matches within a path segment, `**` matches across segments, a leading `./` is stripped, matching is on the repo-relative POSIX path, and forbidden_paths is evaluated after allowed_paths (deny wins).

allowed_paths.description: Paths the worker may write inside the worktree.

forbidden_patterns.description: Command patterns; `*` is a wildcard. Defence-in-depth only.

glob.description: Repo-relative POSIX glob. `..`, absolute paths and NUL are rejected at match time.
